banner: uname -a; uname -r; uname -m; cat /proc/version; cat /etc/os-release; cat /proc/cmdline; dmesg | grep -m 1 'Linux version'
boot-dtb:
for p in /sys/firmware/devicetree/base/model /sys/firmware/devicetree/base/compatible; do printf '[%s]
' "$p"; if [ -r "$p" ]; then tr '\000' '
' < "$p"; printf '[READ_EXIT=%s]
' "$?"; fi; done
files:
r=$(uname -r); for p in /proc/config.gz /boot/config-$r /boot/ /sys/kernel/notes /lib/modules/$r/ /usr/lib/modules/$r/; do printf '
[%s]
' "$p"; ls -ld "$p"; test -r "$p"; printf 'readable=%s
' "$?"; done; ls -la /boot/; ls -la /lib/modules/$r/ /usr/lib/modules/$r/; command -v od; command -v tar; command -v sha256sum; command -v base64; command -v readlink
layout: r=$(uname -r); id; ls -ld /lib /usr/lib /usr/lib/modules /lib/modules; stat -Lc '%d:%i %n' /lib/modules/$r /usr/lib/modules/$r; readlink -f /lib/modules/$r; readlink -f /usr/lib/modules/$r; cat /proc/self/mountinfo; df -h /boot; [ ! -e /sys/firmware/devicetree/base/model ] || cat /sys/firmware/devicetree/base/model
boot-candidates: for d in /boot /opt/boot /opt/usr /usr/lib/kernel /usr/share /lib/firmware; do if [ -d "$d" ]; then printf '\n[%s]\n' "$d"; find "$d" -maxdepth 2 \( -name 'zImage*' -o -name 'uImage*' -o -name 'vmlinux*' -o -name 'vmlinuz*' -o -name 'kernel*.img' -o -name 'System.map*' -o -name 'config-6.12.80*' \) -print; fi; done; cat /etc/fstab
partition-metadata:
r=$(uname -r)
printf '[Module RPM databases]\n'
ls -la /usr/lib/modules/
ls -ld /usr/lib/modules/var/lib/rpm /usr/lib/modules/usr/lib/sysimage/rpm /usr/lib/modules/rpm /var/lib/rpm /usr/lib/sysimage/rpm
printf '[Block node metadata]\n'
ls -l /dev/mmcblk0* /dev/disk/by-partlabel/* /dev/disk/by-label/*
printf '[Mounted files]\n'
cat /proc/mounts
printf '[Ownership of module root metadata]\n'
for p in /boot "/usr/lib/modules/$r" "/lib/modules/$r" "/usr/lib/modules/$r/modules.builtin" "/lib/modules/$r/modules.builtin"; do rpm -qf "$p"; printf 'rpm_exit=%s %s\n' "$?" "$p"; done
kernel-package-names:
for p in rpi4-linux-kernel linux-kernel kernel kernel-core kernel-modules; do printf '[%s]
' "$p"; rpm -q --qf '%{NAME}|%{EPOCH}|%{VERSION}|%{RELEASE}|%{ARCH}|%{SOURCERPM}|%{BUILDTIME}|%{INSTALLTIME}
' "$p"; printf '[RPM_EXIT=%s]
' "$?"; done
pinned-rpm-device-queries:
r=$(uname -r)
fmt='%{NAME}|%{EPOCH}|%{VERSION}|%{RELEASE}|%{ARCH}|%{SOURCERPM}|%{BUILDTIME}|%{INSTALLTIME}\n'
for p in arm-rpi4-linux-kernel arm-rpi4-linux-kernel-modules linux-tizen-modules-rpi4 arm-rpi4-linux-kernel-devel; do
    printf '[PACKAGE=%s]\n' "$p"
    rpm -q --qf "$fmt" "$p"
    printf '[RPM_EXIT=%s]\n' "$?"
done
for p in /boot/zImage /boot/bcm2711-rpi-4-b.dtb /boot/config-"$r" /lib/modules/"$r"/modules.builtin; do
    printf '[PATH=%s]\n' "$p"
    if [ -r "$p" ]; then sha256sum "$p"; printf '[HASH_EXIT=%s]\n' "$?"; else printf '[UNREADABLE_OR_MISSING]\n'; fi
    rpm -qf --qf "$fmt" "$p"
    printf '[RPM_EXIT=%s]\n' "$?"
done
other-module-roots:
for p in /hal /vendor /opt/modules /usr/local/lib/modules; do printf '[%s]
' "$p"; if [ -d "$p" ]; then find "$p" \( -name '*.ko' -o -name '*.ko.gz' -o -name '*.ko.xz' -o -name '*.ko.zst' \) -print; printf '[FIND_EXIT=%s]
' "$?"; else printf '[ROOT_MISSING]
'; fi; done
module-files:
r=$(uname -r)
root=/usr/lib/modules/$r
paths=$(find "$root" \( -name '*.ko' -o -name '*.ko.gz' -o -name '*.ko.xz' -o -name '*.ko.zst' \) -print)
printf 'FIND_EXIT\t%s\n' "$?"
printf '%s\n' "$paths" | while IFS= read -r p; do
    [ -n "$p" ] || continue
    if [ -L "$p" ]; then
        printf 'FILE\t%s\tsymlink\t%s\n' "$p" "$(readlink "$p")"
    elif [ -f "$p" ]; then
        fi_id=$(stat -c '%d:%i:%s' "$p")
        fi_sum=$(sha256sum "$p")
        printf 'FILE\t%s\tregular\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$p" "$fi_id" "$?" "${fi_sum%% *}"
    else
        printf 'FILE\t%s\tother\n' "$p"
    fi
done
module-owners:
r=$(uname -r)
root=/usr/lib/modules/$r
fmt='%{NAME}|%{EPOCH}|%{VERSION}|%{RELEASE}|%{ARCH}|%{SOURCERPM}|%{BUILDTIME}|%{INSTALLTIME}\n'
paths=$(find "$root" \( -name '*.ko' -o -name '*.ko.gz' -o -name '*.ko.xz' -o -name '*.ko.zst' \) -print)
printf 'FIND_EXIT\t%s\n' "$?"
printf '%s\n' "$paths" | while IFS= read -r p; do
    [ -n "$p" ] || continue
    for candidate in "$p" "${p#/usr}"; do
        result=$(rpm -qf --qf "$fmt" "$candidate" 2>&1)
        status=$?
        printf 'OWNER\t%s\t%s\t%s\n%s\n' "$p" "$candidate" "$status" "$result"
        [ "$status" -ne 0 ] || break
    done
done
loaded-build-ids: for m in binfmt_misc proc_tsm brcmfmac hci_uart brcmutil btbcm kdbus logger dm_bow extcon_usb_fixed inform_reboot; do d=/sys/module/$m/notes; printf "[MODULE=%s]\n" "$m"; if [ -r "$d/.note.gnu.build-id" ]; then sha256sum "$d/.note.gnu.build-id"; od -An -v -tx1 "$d/.note.gnu.build-id"; else printf "[BUILD_ID_UNREADABLE]\n"; fi; if [ -r "/sys/module/$m/srcversion" ]; then printf "[SRCVERSION] "; cat "/sys/module/$m/srcversion"; fi; done
